metadata.question: Was water extent in the Sudd wetlands, South Sudan near Bor on December 4, 2021 higher than on December 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking to compare water extent in the Sudd wetlands near Bor, South Sudan between two specific dates: December 4, 2021 vs December 6, 2019. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for water detection 2. Define a region around Bor, South Sudan (coordinates approximately 6.2°N, 31.6°E) 3. Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water: (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) 4. Count water pixels for each date and compare 5. Handle potential issues: no images, cloud cover, etc. Data quality considerations: - Check if images exist for both dates - Check if valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Validate the water detection results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const borGeometry = ee.Geometry.Point([31.5599, 6.2065]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Bor const date2019 = ee.Date('2019-12-06'); const date2021 = ee.Date('2021-12-04'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for water detection function getS2Collection(date, bufferDays = 5) { const startDate = date.advance(-bufferDays, 'day'); const endDate = date.advance(bufferDays, 'day'); return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(borGeometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function calculateNDWI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); } // Get collections for both dates const col2019 = getS2Collection(date2019); const col2021 = getS2Collection(date2021); // Check if collections are empty const count2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); const count2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019-12-06 Images: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2021-12-04 Images: ${count2021}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get best image (least cloudy) for each date const img2019 = col2019.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const img2021 = col2021.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Process images: cloud mask and calculate NDWI const ndwi2019 = calculateNDWI(maskClouds(img2019)); const ndwi2021 = calculateNDWI(maskClouds(img2021)); // Create water mask (NDWI > 0.0 for water) const water2019 = ndwi2019.gt(0.0); const water2021 = ndwi2021.gt(0.0); // Count water pixels const waterCount2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: borGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const waterCount2021 = water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: borGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Count total valid pixels to check if we have data const totalPixels2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: borGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const totalPixels2021 = water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: borGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${waterCount2019}, Total: ${totalPixels2019}`); console.log(`2021 Water Pixels: ${waterCount2021}, Total: ${totalPixels2021}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (totalPixels2019 === 0 || totalPixels2021 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (waterCount2019 === null || waterCount2021 === null || isNaN(waterCount2019) || isNaN(waterCount2021)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare water extent console.log(`Water Extent Ratio (2021/2019): ${(waterCount2021/waterCount2019).toFixed(2)}`); if (waterCount2021 > waterCount2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
